lesson.detail: The pattern is matched against the test's full name: the enclosing suite names and the test name, the same string shown in the reporter output.

test.error: FAIL: -t 'math > adds' did not run the test adds inside describe('math')

source.quote: The pattern is matched against the test's full name: the enclosing suite names and the test name joined with ' > ' (the same string shown in the reporter output). For example, the test below has the full name math > adds, so it is matched by -t 'math > adds' or -t adds:

lesson.subject: vitest
lesson.author: github:you
